name: concept-d-hard-pixel-tilemap
prompt: 16-bit pixel art game screenshot, hard square pixels, low-res tilemap, chunky black outlines, limited colors. No smooth painting, no antialiasing, no gradients, no 3D. Screens are powered on and all different: code, chart, MOBA, FPS, video, download, rank, cards, AFK, fishing. Cow boss behind the back snack counter near shelves. Small pixel UI for player and top 3 token ranking. Clean playable game layout, clear separation, monitors visible, horses do not cover screen interiors. Only readable text: SUB2API.
